message: No detected input validation: The code performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; it simply passes config and dataset objects through factories without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice, and no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are implemented anywhere in the shown files.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against expected sets, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering is applied to training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models and checkpoints via ModelCheckpoint and instantiate_model without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in the provided snippets.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, gradient anomaly detection, activation analysis, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or mechanisms to prevent metric manipulation; metrics are simply computed and saved to text files without integrity controls.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection is visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly to the model/dataset constructors without validation.

No detected output bounds checks: The code records IoU metrics and saves them to files but never checks model outputs for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or other sanity bounds before returning or using them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a 3D point-cloud segmentation pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
